description: This file is a shell script for diagnosing and controlling LED status indicators on specific hardware boards in an OpenWrt environment. It defines functions to determine the status LED based on the board type and to set the LED state according to different system states.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines the appropriate status LED for the board based on its name.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state according to the provided system state parameter.
